name: far-troll-small-simulation
description: NEXT_STEPS item 1: at low graphics settings the game simulates only near 1 / total 3 zones. A far own troll 2 zones from the player (inside the old active-area test, outside the near-1 band) must still have its zone kept by TrollZones, so it does not freeze. The simulation distance is overridden for TrollZones only (stt.zonesSimulation) - the lab never touches the graphics settings.

steps.label: TrollZones sees a small simulation area (near 1, total 3)

steps.name: stt.followTroll
steps.label: the lab follows the troll by its ZDO (its object is removed once it is far)

steps.name: stt.moveTrollFar
steps.label: the troll walks 2 zones away, out of the near-1 band
TrollZones keeps the zone of the far troll although the game's near band no longer covers it
at least one zone is kept
